network.verdict: cleartext permitted app-wide, zero pin-sets, no CT enforcement; transport hardening lives entirely in application code (OkHttp CertificatePinner + host allow-lists), not in the platform config. Effective only if every network path goes through the pinned client — a WebView, a native HTTP client, or an SDK with its own stack bypasses it.
